cheatsheet.title: From activities to an MNC model

intro.description: Describe a mission as a flow of activities and turn it into an MNC model with the bundled transformation.

item.title: Open the example activity flow
item.description: Open demo/example-workspace/MissionPlanning.activity. It declares three activities that hand over to each other.

item.title: Add an activity
item.description: Inside the has activities block press Ctrl+Space and choose the activity template. Fill in the name and the capability it requires.

item.title: Chain it
item.description: Use nextActivity: to point at the following activity. Content assist lists only activities of the same diagram.

item.title: Check the timing
item.description: Add time: 30 secs. The validator warns when an activity that interrupts another has no duration.

item.title: Run the transformation
item.description: Right-click the file and run the activity2mnc transformation from com.smr.activity.activity2mnc. The generated MNC model appears next to the source file.
